title: The Sensor Ghost Evacuation
logline: An atmospheric observatory and an unbaffled ice hauler's exhaust create a phantom sensor anomaly that scientists and merchants misinterpret as an imminent coronal flare.

roles.description: Solar observatory director; terrified of missing a lethal radiation storm, preparing to order full station evacuation.
Representative of independent atmospheric transport barges; desperate to prevent a shutdown that will ruin seasonal cargo runs.
An automated municipal defense skiff enforcing flight bans around the station solar shields.
The scientific observatory monitoring stellar flare telemetry and coronal mass ejections.
The guild of heavy bulk ice and air haulers operating long-range transfer routes.
The inner Lagrange monitoring platform tracking stellar activity.
The civilian orbital habitat preparing to vent its outer rings ahead of the alleged flare.

public_situation: Solar observatories flash red radiation alerts across {system}, prompting authorities at {role:orbital_station} to order an emergency civilian evacuation.
private_truth: The terrifying spectral spike is an artifact caused by unbaffled water vapor vented by an uninspected cargo barge crossing the telescope lens.

beats.public_change: Evacuation sirens sound across {role:orbital_station} while emergency ferries prepare to seal docking portals.

missions.reason: She hires an outside pilot to deliver structural ferrite plates to reinforce the observatory's radiation shielding before the flare strikes.
missions.private_fact: Her predecessor was sacked for failing to predict a minor flare six years ago, and she is terrified of second-guessing her instruments.

beats.public_change: Freight barge captains protest the total shutdown of shipping corridors, claiming their sensors register zero coronal magnetic buildup.

missions.reason: He hires the pilot to scan the observatory's primary spectral sensor array and correlate the readings with recent freighter flight tracks.
missions.private_fact: His flagship hauler has an illegal unbaffled cooling exhaust that was venting directly across the telescope's focus twenty minutes before the alert.

beats.public_change: {role:picket_sentry} begins firing warning bursts at idling commercial barges to force them out of the station approach lanes.

missions.reason: He needs the automated sentry's targeting array disabled so trapped freighters can clear the docking corridor without being destroyed.
missions.private_fact: The sentry hails offering twenty thousand credits and priority evacuation clearance if the pilot lets the lockdown continue.

beats.public_change: Habitat directors at {role:orbital_station} initiate the final sequence to vent atmosphere from commercial berths.

missions.reason: He asks the pilot to courier the correlated telemetry dossier to the station command center before the airlock seals are blown.
missions.private_fact: If the truth comes out, his syndicate will be sued by the port authority for billions in emergency response costs.

player_choice.prompt: The pilot arrives at station command holding mathematical proof that the apocalyptic solar flare is merely water vapor from an uninspected hauler.

options.label: Deliver the telemetry proof to abort the evacuation and reopen station berths
Suppress the telemetry to let the panic inflate emergency fuel and oxygen spot prices
Endorse the evacuation order to ensure government relief payouts for all parties

resolutions.reached_by: The pilot delivers the correlated telemetry, proving the flare reading was an exhaust artifact.
resolutions.summary: The flare alert is cancelled. {role:chief_meteorologist} stands down the sirens, and {role:freight_barge_guild} resumes commercial transit without loss of life.

consequences.public_summary: A pilot proved that an extinction-level solar flare was just water vapor from an uninspected cargo hauler.

resolutions.reached_by: The telemetry is suppressed, allowing commodity speculators to exploit the false panic.
resolutions.summary: Panic spreads across the system. Life-support prices surge, enriching traders while {role:freight_barge_guild} absorbs catastrophic penalties.

resolutions.reached_by: The evacuation is carried through without verification, causing massive dislocation.
resolutions.summary: The station berths are evacuated and vented. The economic collapse strands hundreds of workers, devastating {role:orbital_station} for months.

loose_threads.detail: The observatory's primary spectral sensors were manufactured by a firm owned by an inner-system disaster relief contractor.
The ice barge's cooling fluid manifest logs an unlisted aromatic compound that emits heavy ultraviolet fluorescent blooms when heated.

radio_hooks: Observatory sirens urge civilian ships to seek radiation bunkers immediately.
Freight guild spokesmen denounce emergency port shutdowns as unscientific panic.
Trading desks report record volume in short-term life-support derivative options.

voice_direction.chief_meteorologist: Rapid, high-strung, and clinical. Speaks in breathless paragraphs of astrophysical telemetry and refuses to entertain non-catastrophic hypotheses.
voice_direction.hauler_syndic: Blunt, hard-headed, and skeptical. Believes academics create emergencies to justify research subsidies and swears by grease and dials.
